keyFeatures: Dormer loft conversion with full building regulations approval as master suite
Double integral garage with automated doors
Driveway for 4 cars with 7kW EV charger installed
Dedicated study / home office and separate utility room
South-west facing landscaped garden with composite decking and garden room

text.description: An outstanding four bedroom detached family residence positioned in a prime Solihull avenue. The ground floor features an expansive hall, front lounge, separate study / home office, open-plan kitchen breakfast room with island, utility room with garden access, and guest downstairs WC. Internal door leads to a double integral garage. The second floor features a luxury dormer loft conversion with full building regulations approval, boasting a bespoke dressing area and private en-suite bathroom. Outside, a wide in-out driveway provides parking for 4 vehicles equipped with a 7kW EV charger. The rear garden is south-west facing with a composite deck, lawn, and an insulated garden office with power and light. Eco features include a solar PV array.
